gui.shadows_things.class.title: Class
class.shadows_things.warrior.name: Warrior
class.shadows_things.warrior.description:
A balanced frontline fighter skilled in standard weaponry and reliable physical combat.
- Well-rounded stats for any situation
- Mastery over swords and shields
class.shadows_things.archer.name: Archer
class.shadows_things.archer.description:
A master of ranged combat, capable of eliminating targets from a distance with lethal precision.
- High agility and movement speed
- Specialized in bows and crossbows
class.shadows_things.berserker.name: Berserker
class.shadows_things.berserker.descripti:
A ferocious warrior who thrives in the heat of battle, trading defense for devastating raw power.
- Gains strength as health drops
- Excels in close-quarters combat
class.shadows_things.fire_mage.name: Fire Mage
class.shadows_things.fire_mage.descripti:
A spellcaster wielding the destructive forces of flame to incinerate groups of enemies.
- High magical damage output
- Applies burning effects to targets
class.shadows_things.paladin.name: Paladin
class.shadows_things.paladin.description:
A holy knight combining heavy armor with protective and supportive divine magic.
- Exceptional defense and survivability
- Protects allies in dangerous situations
